# Research paper — Style Prompt

> A page from a research paper, read one section at a time. Warm white paper, a column of faint line numbers down the left edge, black serif type and one plot blue. A centred chapter card fades up glyph by glyph over a 1 px rule; the page dips to paper and a section opens with an italic kicker, a heading whose number gets a thin blue frame drawn around it, then numbered reference rows `[1] [2] [3]`. Another dip, a beat of empty page, and one bold serif figure counts exactly to its decimal and locks, its unit and source following, the sample size boxed. A figure caption and a colophon with legend dots sit under every page. Quiet, exact and almost motionless: it reads as evidence.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

The film is **a reviewed manuscript**: the line-number gutter, the "Gambar 1:" caption and the colophon never move, and three page layouts take turns above them on an 80 px margin:

- the **chapter**, centred: a bold numeral, the title, a 220 px hairline rule, an italic note (block top at y 700);
- the **section**: an italic kicker and a heading at y 296, reference rows from y 660;
- the **figure**, centred: one big bold serif number with a superscript unit sign, a unit line and an italic source note (top at y 640).

Emphasis is **only a thin frame** drawn around one number or word (a boxed result, as in a maths paper), and that word turns plot blue. Pages change with a **dip to the paper colour**. Text arrives by fading up a few pixels, glyph after glyph; after that nothing moves until the next dip.

What it is not: no coloured backgrounds or decorative shapes; no highlighter, underline scribbles or colour fills for emphasis; no bounce, overshoot, big moves or motion blur; no camera; not a slide deck (no icons, cards, shadows, gradients); never a fake screenshot of a real paper or journal. When the content reviews a real study, the screen names its authors and year.

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **Paper**: one flat warm white ground. No grain, no vignette, no texture.
- **Ink**: near-black type, a mid grey for secondary text; the only colours are the plot blue (frames, boxed words, row indices, a legend dot) and, rarely, the plot red.
- **Line-number gutter**: numbers 1-36 right-aligned in a 46 px column at x 14, first line at y 172, 44 px pitch, mono 18 px in the grey at 55% opacity. It runs past the page body and is never animated. One text element with newline-joined numbers, not 36 nodes.
- **Hairlines**: the chapter rule is 1 px ink at 85%, 220 px wide, centred, 30 px under the title. Legend dots carry a 1 px ring of ink at 10%.
- **The frame**: an SVG rectangle (`pathLength` 100) around the word, extending 0.16em left and right and slightly above the cap height, stroke 2.5 px in the blue, no fill, square corners. The boxed word keeps 0.14em of space on each side so the frame never touches its neighbours.
- **Reference rows**: a mono index `[1]` in blue (30 px, 70 px column, 28 px gap), then a 56 px serif line; 20 px padding top and bottom (104 px pitch). No rules between rows, no bullets.
- **Figure**: 280 px bold serif, line height 0.9, tracking −0.05em, tabular lining figures, the unit sign at 0.42em top-aligned beside it; the unit line 64 px 18 px below; the source note 48 px italic in ink 36 px below that.
- **Caption and colophon**: "Gambar 1:" in bold ink followed by the caption in grey (28 px, bottom at y 1404); then a mono series label (22 px, tracked 0.3em), the name in the title serif at 60 px with a muted bold tail at 34 px, and four 34 px legend dots 10 px apart (page white, ink, blue, red). Bottom at y 1620. The dip covers them with the page.

## 3. Colour logic

- `--latar` is the paper, and the dip layer, so a page turn always fades to the brand's own ground.
- `--latar-2` is the page white: only the first legend dot (nearly invisible on the paper, as in a real legend), or a rare figure panel.
- `--utama` plays the **plot blue** (the first series colour of a scientific chart). Everything blue sits on paper, so it is drawn in `--utama-di-latar`: the frame, the boxed word, the row indices, a plotted line. `--utama` itself only fills the blue legend dot or a plotted area. With a pale brand (light yellow on white) `--utama-di-latar` falls back to ink: the frame and the boxed word turn black and still read as a boxed result.
- `--aksen` plays the **plot red**, the second series: the red legend dot, a second line in a comparison, a worst value. Words in red use `--aksen-di-latar`. Never more than one red element on a page.
- `--teks` is the ink: titles, headings, rows, the figure, the unit, the source note, "Gambar 1:", the colophon name, the ink dot. `--teks-redup` is the grey: the gutter, the italic kicker and chapter note, the caption text, the mono label, the colophon tail.
- `--teks-di-utama` and `--teks-di-aksen`: no text sits on a colour field in this look. If a button is unavoidable, frame the contact instead of filling it.
- Fixed in every brand: no hue. Hairlines and rings are ink mixed with transparency (`--garis`, ink at 10%), so a dark brand gets a dark manuscript with light ink and the gutter follows.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul` carries the chapter numeral (150 px, 700, tracking −0.04em), the chapter title (116 px, 400), the section heading (84 px, 400), the figure (280 px, 700) and the colophon name (60 px). **Libre Baskerville**: the closest bundled face to a classic maths-paper serif. Titles get a hair of weight with `-webkit-text-stroke: 0.012em`; line height 1.12, `text-wrap: balance`, never broken inside a word.
- `--font-isi` carries the rows (56 px), the unit line (64 px) and the caption (28 px, "Gambar 1:" in 700): **Libre Baskerville 400**. One family for the whole page, like a typeset paper.
- `--font-catatan` (a look token): **Cormorant Garamond 500 italic** for the kicker and the chapter note (40 px, grey) and the figure's source note (48 px, ink). It stands in for the paper's italic; Cormorant runs small, so it is set about 1.3× the size the source used.
- `--font-kode` (a look token): **IBM Plex Mono 600** for the gutter (18 px), the row indices (30 px) and the series label (22 px, tracked 0.3em, uppercase).
- Decimals follow the language: a comma in Indonesian (`92,4%`).
- When the brand has no fonts: Libre Baskerville, or Cormorant Garamond 700 for a lighter page; Playfair Display only for the figure (set `lining-nums`).
- Room: a 116 px title holds about 10 characters on one line; a heading at 84 px about 18. A figure longer than five characters drops to about 220 px.

## 5. Motion quality

- **Eases**: enter `cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1)` (the timeline core has no custom-ease plugin here, so pass a small function that solves the curve), exit `power1.in`, frame and count `power2.inOut`. No overshoot.
- **Text in (fade-up)**: each glyph from opacity 0 and y +14 px to rest in 0.6 s, staggered 0.012 s, capped at min(0.012, 0.4 / (glyphs − 1)) so a line is in within 1 s. Lines of one block start 0.1 s apart. The source also softens glyphs from a 4 px blur; that is dropped (see Pitfalls).
- **Chapter**: one thing at a time: numeral at 0 s (already 30% visible on frame 0), title 0.25 s, rule from the centre 0.55 s (scaleX 0 → 1 in 0.6 s), note 0.8 s. Built by 1.4 s, held to 2.75 s.
- **Frame**: dash offset 100 → 0 in 0.55 s `power2.inOut`, clockwise from the top-left corner; the boxed word blends from ink to blue in 0.3 s starting 0.3 s into the draw. It stays.
- **Rows (fade-rows)**: opacity 0 → 1 and x −16 px → 0 in 0.6 s, 0.4 s apart, the first 0.7 s after the heading's frame starts.
- **Figure (decimal tracker)**: 0.4 s of empty page after the dip, then the figure fades in over 0.25 s while it counts from 0 over 1.3 s `power2.inOut`, one exact value per frame, decimals kept (0 → 4,3 → 24,2 → 67,7 → 84,6 → 92,4 at quarter seconds). After it locks: the unit line 0.1 s later, the source note 0.2 s after that, the frame around the sample size 0.8 s after the note.
- **Dip**: a paper-coloured layer over everything fades in 0.3 s `power1.in`, the pages swap while covered, and it fades out in 0.4 s `power1.out`. Text never exits on its own.
- **Holds**: chapter at least 1.2 s after it is built, a section 1.6 s, the figure 2.2 s after it locks; the ending holds 2.6 s.

## 6. Camera grammar

There is no camera: the page lies still on the desk and only the type arrives.

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Locked frame, no drift | a document: exact, nothing to hide | always |
| Dip to paper (0.3 s in, 0.4 s out) | turning to the next section | every change of beat |
| Empty page for 0.4 s | anticipation before a result | before a figure or a verdict |
| Hold | reading time, confidence in the data | after each page is built, at least 1.2-2.2 s |
| No pans, zooms, shakes or cuts | — | — |

## 7. Native moves

- **The centred chapter card.** A bold numeral, the title fading up glyph by glyph, a 220 px rule growing from the centre, an italic note. *Fits content like:* "01 Air Jernih" opening an aquarium shop's care report; "Bab 2 · Fotosintesis" for a biology class; a creator's paper-review series "03 Tidur Siang"; "Hari Pertama" for a diary-style story.
- **The boxed result.** A thin blue frame draws clockwise around one number or word, which turns blue and stays boxed. *Fits content like:* the "3" in "Cukup 3 kebiasaan"; the sample size in a source note; the term being defined in a lesson; the one clue that matters in a mystery.
- **Reference rows.** Mono indices `[1] [2] [3]` in blue, each serif line fading in from 16 px to the left, 0.4 s apart. *Fits content like:* three care habits from a shop's own records; three findings of a study a creator explains; three requirements for a course; three witnesses in a short story.
- **The decimal tracker.** After a beat of empty page, a bold serif figure counts exactly to its decimal and locks; the unit and the source follow. *Fits content like:* "92,4% ikan tetap sehat"; "4,8 jam" of study time saved in a tutoring class; a channel's "61,3%" average view duration; "1,2 km" left to walk in a travel story.
- **The manuscript frame.** The line-number gutter, a "Gambar 1:" caption and a colophon with legend dots stay on every page. *Fits content like:* a shop's monthly report with its series number; a creator's review episode; a course module and its number; a serial story's chapter.
- **The dip to paper.** Everything fades to the paper colour and the next section rises out of it. *Fits content like:* method to result; question to answer; one step of a guide to the next; "keesokan paginya".

## 8. Pitfalls

- **Evidence, not decoration.** Every figure needs a source line and a sample size, and the caption says where the data came from. Never invent figures for a real business; never imitate a real journal page, author or paper.
- **One emphasis per page.** One frame per page; no highlighter, no colour fill, no bold colour words besides the boxed one.
- **Blur budget.** The source blurs each glyph 4 px on entry; an animated blur on dozens of glyphs breaks the preview budget, so glyphs only fade and rise.
- **Splitting glyphs.** Keep spaces as text nodes (an inline-block space indents a wrapped line) and each word's glyphs in a nowrap box; split before adding the frame.
- **The frame.** `overflow: visible` on the SVG, `pathLength="100"` and `stroke-dasharray: 100` on the rectangle; give the boxed word side margins or the frame touches the next word.
- **The blue word.** the timeline cannot tween between `var()` colours: mix the word's colour with `color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama-di-latar) calc(var(--k) * 100%), currentColor)` and tween `--k`.
- **Counting.** One `tl.set` per frame from the eased value, formatted with a decimal comma; the centred figure widens as digits appear, which is part of the look. The last frame shows the exact value.
- **Initial states.** Hide later pages with `gsap.set` outside the timeline; start the opening dip with `fromTo` so frame 0 is already rendered.
- **Small type.** The gutter (18 px), the mono label (22 px) and the caption (28 px) sit below the usual 40 px floor: they are attribution and texture only. The colophon lies in the bottom 420 px where app buttons can cover it: never put a price or the only contact there; a call to action gets its own page above y 1500.
- **Brands.** Pale brands turn the frame black; dark brands turn the whole manuscript dark and the dip follows, since it is `--latar`. Do not rescue either with a second colour.

## Measured from the reference

- 14.4 s in three pages: chapter 0-3.05 s, section 3.05-9.05 s, figure 9.05 s to the end; dips start at 2.75 s and 8.75 s and cover 0.3 s later.
- Chapter built by 1.4 s; the section's heading in by 3.9 s, its frame drawn 4.1-4.65 s, rows at 4.8, 5.2 and 5.6 s; the figure counts 9.45-10.75 s, unit at 10.85 s, note at 11.05 s, its frame 11.85-12.4 s, then about 2 s of hold.
- Palette: paper #fdfcf8, page white #ffffff, ink #111111, grey #666666, plot blue #1f77b4, plot red #d62728, hairlines ink at 12%.

# Research paper: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 3, medium 4.5, long 6.

## hook

- en: a centred chapter card: bold number, the title fading up letter by letter, a 1 px rule from the centre, an italic note
- id: kartu bab di tengah: nomor tebal, judul muncul per huruf, garis 1 px dari tengah, catatan miring

## problem

- en: the problem as one calm sentence; its key word boxed in a thin blue frame drawn clockwise, nothing shakes
- id: masalah sebagai satu kalimat tenang; kata kuncinya dibingkai garis biru tipis searah jarum jam, tanpa guncangan

## fact

- en: a definition as in a paper: italic kicker, the term in serif, one plain line under it, cited in the figure caption
- id: definisi ala makalah: kicker miring, istilah dalam serif, satu kalimat polos di bawahnya, dirujuk di keterangan gambar

## step

- en: a numbered reference list: [1] [2] [3] in blue mono, each row fading in from 16 px left, 0.4 s apart
- id: daftar rujukan bernomor: [1] [2] [3] mono biru, tiap baris masuk pelan dari kiri, jeda 0,4 detik

## compare

- en: two values drawn as a plot: hairline axes, a blue and a red series, legend dots; the better value boxed
- id: dua nilai digambar seperti grafik makalah: sumbu tipis, seri biru dan merah, titik legenda; nilai unggul dibingkai

## number

- en: the figure counts exactly to one decimal in bold serif and locks; the unit and the source fade up after it
- id: angka dihitung persis sampai satu desimal dalam serif tebal lalu terkunci; satuan dan sumber menyusul pelan

## proof

- en: the source as a citation: an italic note with the sample size boxed, the caption naming where the data came from
- id: sumber sebagai kutipan: catatan miring dengan jumlah sampel dibingkai, keterangan gambar menyebut asal data

## offer

- en: the offer as a boxed result in the headline: the price or benefit framed in blue, its details as reference rows
- id: penawaran sebagai hasil berbingkai di judul: harga atau manfaat dibingkai biru, rinciannya jadi baris rujukan

## cta

- en: a closing reference: the name in serif, the contact as entry [1], the handle boxed, held still 2 s
- id: penutup seperti daftar pustaka: nama dalam serif, kontak sebagai entri [1], akun dibingkai, diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: the key figure counted and locked, its source boxed, the page held still at least 2 s
- id: angka kunci dihitung lalu terkunci, sumbernya dibingkai, halaman diam minimal 2 detik

<!doctype html>
<html lang="id">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=1080, height=1920" />
    <title>Makalah ilmiah</title>
    <script src="/_lib/gsap@3.15.1/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <style>
      @font-face { font-family: "Libre Baskerville"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 400; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Libre Baskerville"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 700; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Cormorant Garamond"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 500; font-style: italic; }
      @font-face { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 600; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama. */
      :root {
        --latar: #fdfcf8; --latar-2: #ffffff; --utama: #1f77b4; --aksen: #d62728;
        --teks: #111111; --teks-redup: #666666; --teks-di-utama: #ffffff;
        --teks-di-aksen: #ffffff; --utama-di-latar: #1f77b4; --aksen-di-latar: #d62728;
        --font-judul: "Libre Baskerville", "Noto Sans", serif; --font-isi: "Libre Baskerville", "Noto Sans", serif;
        /* Milik tampilan: catatan miring ala LaTeX, mono untuk nomor baris dan indeks, garis tipis. */
        --font-catatan: "Cormorant Garamond", var(--font-isi); --font-kode: "IBM Plex Mono", monospace;
        --garis: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 10%, transparent);
      }
      * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
      html, body { width: 1080px; height: 1920px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); }
      #root { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar);
        color: var(--teks); font-family: var(--font-isi); -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
      .adegan { position: absolute; inset: 0; }
      em { font-style: normal; }
      .wd { display: inline-block; white-space: nowrap; }
      .ch { display: inline-block; white-space: pre; }

      /* Alur nomor baris di kiri, seperti naskah yang sedang ditinjau */
      #alur { position: absolute; left: 14px; top: 150px; width: 46px; text-align: right; white-space: pre;
        font-family: var(--font-kode); font-weight: 600; font-size: 18px; line-height: 44px; color: var(--teks-redup); opacity: 0.55; }

      .judul { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.12; -webkit-text-stroke: 0.012em currentColor; word-break: keep-all; text-wrap: balance; }
      .catatan { font-family: var(--font-catatan); font-style: italic; font-weight: 500; font-size: 40px; color: var(--teks-redup); }

      /* Bab: di tengah, nomor tebal, garis 1 px selebar 220 px */
      .bab { position: absolute; left: 70px; right: 70px; top: 700px; text-align: center; }
      .bab .no { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 700; font-size: 150px; line-height: 0.9; letter-spacing: -0.04em; }
      .bab .judul { margin-top: 26px; font-size: 116px; }
      .bab .rule { width: 220px; height: 1px; margin: 30px auto 0; background: var(--teks); opacity: 0.85; }
      .bab .catatan { margin-top: 26px; }

      /* Artikel: kepala di 300 px, daftar rujukan mulai 660 px */
      .kepala { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; top: 296px; }
      .kepala .judul { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 84px; }
      .daftar { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; top: 660px; list-style: none; }
      .daftar li { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 28px; padding: 20px 0; }
      .daftar .idx { min-width: 70px; font-family: var(--font-kode); font-weight: 600; font-size: 30px; color: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      .daftar .txt { font-family: var(--font-isi); font-size: 56px; line-height: 1.15; }

      /* Angka: di tengah, persen kecil menempel di kanan atas */
      .stat { position: absolute; left: 100px; right: 100px; top: 640px; text-align: center; }
      .stat .val { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 700; font-size: 280px; line-height: 0.9; letter-spacing: -0.05em;
        font-variant-numeric: lining-nums tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }
      .stat .val::after { content: attr(data-suffix); display: inline-block; font-size: 0.42em; letter-spacing: 0;
        margin-left: 0.04em; vertical-align: top; line-height: 1; padding-top: 0.1em; }
      .stat .unit { margin-top: 18px; font-family: var(--font-isi); font-size: 64px; }
      .stat .catatan { margin-top: 36px; font-size: 48px; color: var(--teks); }

      /* \boxed{}: bingkai tipis digambar searah jarum jam dari pojok kiri atas, lalu tinggal */
      .kotak { position: relative; display: inline-block; margin: 0 0.14em; --k: 0;
        color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama-di-latar) calc(var(--k) * 100%), currentColor); }
      .kotak svg { position: absolute; left: -0.16em; top: -0.04em; width: calc(100% + 0.32em); height: calc(100% + 0.06em); overflow: visible; }
      .kotak rect { fill: none; stroke: var(--utama-di-latar); stroke-width: 2.5; stroke-dasharray: 100; }

      /* Keterangan gambar dan kolofon: kaki halaman yang tinggal sepanjang video */
      .ket { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; bottom: 516px; font-family: var(--font-isi); font-size: 28px;
        line-height: 1.5; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      .ket b { color: var(--teks); font-weight: 700; }
      .kolofon { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; bottom: 300px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }
      .kolofon .k { font-family: var(--font-kode); font-weight: 600; font-size: 22px; letter-spacing: 0.3em; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      .kolofon .n { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; column-gap: 18px; font-family: var(--font-judul); font-size: 60px; line-height: 1.15; }
      .kolofon .n small { font-weight: 700; font-size: 34px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      .kolofon .sw { display: flex; gap: 10px; }
      .kolofon .sw i { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%; outline: 1px solid var(--garis); }
      .kolofon .sw i:nth-child(1) { background: var(--latar-2); }
      .kolofon .sw i:nth-child(2) { background: var(--teks); }
      .kolofon .sw i:nth-child(3) { background: var(--utama); }
      .kolofon .sw i:nth-child(4) { background: var(--aksen); }

      /* Celup: lapisan warna kertas yang menutup semuanya sebentar di antara adegan */
      #celup { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 50; background: var(--latar); }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1080" data-height="1920" data-fps="30">
      <div id="alur"></div>

      <!-- 1 hook: nomor bab, judul muncul per huruf, garis tipis dari tengah, catatan miring -->
      <section class="adegan" id="s1" data-role="hook">
        <div class="bab">
          <div class="no naik">01</div>
          <div class="judul naik">Air Jernih</div>
          <div class="rule"></div>
          <div class="catatan naik">Studi kasus · akuarium air tawar</div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- 2 step: kicker miring, judul dengan angka dibingkai, lalu daftar [1] [2] [3] masuk satu per satu -->
      <section class="adegan" id="s2" data-role="step">
        <div class="kepala">
          <div class="catatan naik">Catatan perawatan</div>
          <div class="judul naik">Cukup <em class="kotak">3</em> kebiasaan</div>
        </div>
        <ol class="daftar">
          <li><span class="idx">[1]</span><span class="txt">Filter tiga lapis</span></li>
          <li><span class="idx">[2]</span><span class="txt">Ganti air 20% seminggu</span></li>
          <li><span class="idx">[3]</span><span class="txt">Pakan sekali sehari</span></li>
        </ol>
      </section>

      <!-- 3 payoff: diam sebentar, angka dihitung persis sampai satu desimal, satuan dan sumber menyusul, sumber dibingkai -->
      <section class="adegan" id="s3" data-role="payoff">
        <div class="stat">
          <div class="val" data-suffix="%">92,4</div>
          <div class="unit naik">ikan tetap sehat</div>
          <div class="catatan naik">Minggu ke-8 · <em class="kotak">250</em> akuarium</div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <div class="ket"><b>Gambar 1:</b> Catatan pelanggan Teluk Biru, Jan–Jun 2026.</div>
      <div class="kolofon">
        <div class="k">LAPORAN 03 / 12</div>
        <div class="n">Teluk Biru<small>Akuarium Air Tawar</small></div>
        <div class="sw"><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i></div>
      </div>
      <div id="celup"></div>
    </div>

    <script>
      const q = (s, r = document) => Array.from(r.querySelectorAll(s));
      const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
      // Kurva masuk sumbernya: cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1), diselesaikan dengan Newton
